scope: R4 first bundle (plan §4): cases with source/time/answer basis, inputs that must be withheld, and explanation/tool-selection evaluation against the existing manual procedure. Built only from recorded evidence; no new model or cluster calls.

cases.source: experiments/dogfood-diagnosis/cases.json (7) + synthetic variants (counterexample-unmarked, supported-recovery-directive, relation-same, relation-different)
cases.withheld_by_code: stale-injection, stale-same-target, unknown-time, fresh-other-target: excluded before any model call with stated reasons (tests/test_snapshot_diagnosis.py).

model_cases.lookalike: known model limit; human review boundary per D53 (relation-probe/review.json)

manual_baseline.definition: Standard read-only Kubernetes triage for a failing rollout: describe deployment, rollout status, list pods in the namespace, current logs, and previous-container logs when restarts are present. No written investigation runbook exists in src/agents/runbooks (its catalog holds remediation runbooks only), so this baseline is stated here rather than taken from the repo.
manual_baseline.timing: Not measured: no human-operated run was timed. No speed-up claim is made.

tool_selection.evidence: live-api-scoped/tool-calls.jsonl, verification.json (W isolated API18779 and UI13001, 2026-10-19/20 UTC)
tool_selection.match: 4 of the 5 baseline reads, scoped to the target namespace/deployment; retry0; the earlier failed arm requested cluster-wide list_namespaces, refused by the guard and kept as failed.
tool_selection.gap: Previous-container logs: ops_tools.get_logs has no previous option. investigation_proposals surfaces previous_container_logs as a human-facing next-evidence proposal that already states availability/access are not verified, so this is not a contract defect; adding the option would expand the fixed Investigate5 toolset and needs a scope decision. If expanded: reproduce on a restarted pod (kind cluster currently down: Docker daemon not running), then re-measure selection under cache control.
tool_selection.duration: API run a3ee1c17 10.739 s end-to-end, 4 reads. Supplied-snapshot candidate calls median 5.01 s (3.54-6.82, n=10, local MLX). Local compute time and memory are not zero cost.

explanation_quality: Correct for counterexample (with guard) and supported-recovery; lookalike overclaims and is left to human review; the snapshot path never widens execution (tools 0, execution_authorized false) and labels interpretation unverified.
verdict: R4 first bundle assembled with stated limits: manual timing absent, previous-log gap open, lookalike under D53. Not a model accuracy estimate (small deterministic samples).
